name: As of Stage Number
description: Latest selected stage; no selection means stage 21.

name: Snapshot Label
expression: "STANDINGS AFTER STAGE " & FORMAT([As of Stage Number], "00")

name: Eligible Riders
expression: VAR s = [As of Stage Number] RETURN CALCULATE(SUM('Standing'[Eligible]), REMOVEFILTERS('Stage'), 'Standing'[Stage] = s)

name: Exited Riders
expression: VAR s=[As of Stage Number] RETURN COALESCE(COUNTROWS(FILTER('Rider',NOT ISBLANK('Rider'[Exit Stage]) && 'Rider'[Exit Stage]<=s)),0)
description: Explicit withdrawals by the selected stage; incomplete results alone are not an exit.

name: Eligible Cumulative Hours
expression: VAR s = [As of Stage Number] RETURN CALCULATE(DIVIDE(CALCULATE(SUM('Standing'[Cumulative Seconds]), 'Standing'[Eligible] = 1),3600), REMOVEFILTERS('Stage'), 'Standing'[Stage] = s)
description: Sum of eligible riders cumulative adjusted time in the selected rider/team slice.

name: Rider Cumulative Seconds
expression: IF(HASONEVALUE('Rider'[Bib]), VAR s = [As of Stage Number] RETURN CALCULATE(CALCULATE(MAX('Standing'[Cumulative Seconds]), 'Standing'[Eligible]=1), REMOVEFILTERS('Stage'), 'Standing'[Stage] = s))

name: Rider Cumulative Time
expression: VAR t=[Rider Cumulative Seconds] RETURN IF(NOT ISBLANK(t), FORMAT(INT(t/3600),"0") & ":" & FORMAT(INT(MOD(t,3600)/60),"00") & ":" & FORMAT(MOD(t,60),"00"))

name: GC Rank
expression: IF(HASONEVALUE('Rider'[Bib]), VAR s = [As of Stage Number] RETURN CALCULATE(MAX('Standing'[GC Rank]), REMOVEFILTERS('Stage'), 'Standing'[Stage] = s))
description: Global competition rank. Preserved under rider/team filtering; blank when ineligible.

name: Points Rank
expression: IF(HASONEVALUE('Rider'[Bib]), VAR s = [As of Stage Number] RETURN CALCULATE(MAX('Standing'[Points Rank]), REMOVEFILTERS('Stage'), 'Standing'[Stage] = s))
description: Global competition rank. Preserved under rider/team filtering; blank when ineligible.

name: KOM Rank
expression: IF(HASONEVALUE('Rider'[Bib]), VAR s = [As of Stage Number] RETURN CALCULATE(MAX('Standing'[KOM Rank]), REMOVEFILTERS('Stage'), 'Standing'[Stage] = s))
description: Global competition rank. Preserved under rider/team filtering; blank when ineligible.

name: Young Rank
expression: IF(HASONEVALUE('Rider'[Bib]), VAR s = [As of Stage Number] RETURN CALCULATE(MAX('Standing'[Young Rank]), REMOVEFILTERS('Stage'), 'Standing'[Stage] = s))
description: Global competition rank. Preserved under rider/team filtering; blank when ineligible.

name: Cumulative Points
expression: VAR s = [As of Stage Number] RETURN CALCULATE(CALCULATE(SUM('Standing'[Points]), 'Standing'[Eligible]=1), REMOVEFILTERS('Stage'), 'Standing'[Stage] = s)

name: Cumulative KOM Points
expression: VAR s = [As of Stage Number] RETURN CALCULATE(CALCULATE(SUM('Standing'[KOM Points]), 'Standing'[Eligible]=1), REMOVEFILTERS('Stage'), 'Standing'[Stage] = s)

name: Rider Status
expression: IF(HASONEVALUE('Rider'[Bib]), VAR s = [As of Stage Number] RETURN CALCULATE(SELECTEDVALUE('Standing'[Status]), REMOVEFILTERS('Stage'), 'Standing'[Stage] = s))

name: GC Gap Seconds
expression: VAR t=[Rider Cumulative Seconds] VAR s=[As of Stage Number] VAR leader=CALCULATE(MIN('Standing'[Cumulative Seconds]),REMOVEFILTERS('Rider'),REMOVEFILTERS('Stage'),'Standing'[Stage]=s,'Standing'[Eligible]=1) RETURN IF(NOT ISBLANK(t),t-leader)
description: Gap to global GC leader, seconds.

name: Classification Rider Hours
expression: VAR c=SELECTEDVALUE('Classification'[Classification]) RETURN IF(c="Young Rider",CALCULATE([Eligible Cumulative Hours],'Rider'[Young Rider]=1),[Eligible Cumulative Hours])
description: The same eligible field participates in General, Points and Mountains; time is not their points score.

name: Running Rider Hours
description: All stage types through the x-axis stage; includes historical completed effort before exits.

name: Best Team Rank
expression: IF(HASONEVALUE('Team'[Team]), VAR s = [As of Stage Number] RETURN CALCULATE(MAX('Team Standing'[Team Rank]), REMOVEFILTERS('Stage'), 'Team Standing'[Stage] = s))
description: Rank by stages scored DESC, then cumulative stage top-3 time ASC.

name: Team Cumulative Hours
expression: VAR s = [As of Stage Number] RETURN CALCULATE(DIVIDE(SUM('Team Standing'[Cumulative Top3 Seconds]),3600), REMOVEFILTERS('Stage'), 'Team Standing'[Stage] = s)

name: Stages Scored
expression: IF(HASONEVALUE('Team'[Team]), VAR s = [As of Stage Number] RETURN CALCULATE(MAX('Team Standing'[Stages Scored]), REMOVEFILTERS('Stage'), 'Team Standing'[Stage] = s))

name: Team Coverage
expression: IF(HASONEVALUE('Team'[Team]), VAR s = [As of Stage Number] RETURN CALCULATE(SELECTEDVALUE('Team Standing'[Coverage]), REMOVEFILTERS('Stage'), 'Team Standing'[Stage] = s))

name: Teams by Country
description: Country dimension intentionally applies team nationality independently.

name: Riders by Country
description: Registered rider nationality, independent of team nationality; includes exited riders.

name: Roster Riders
description: Intersection of selected country and roster hierarchy; blank hides unrelated roster branches.
